description: Cancel a booking under its cancellation terms. Without confirm: true it only shows what would be refunded, so you can check with the person first. To cancel, call again with confirm: true and expectedRefund set to the wouldRefund they agreed to; if the refund has changed since (a deadline passed), nothing is cancelled and you get the new amount. Card refunds go back automatically.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually cancel

expectedRefund.description: With confirm: the wouldRefund from the preview, e.g. '₦40,000'

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
